_comment: Hand picks for infra/pick_stills.py, keyed by YouTube video id. `frame` pins a candidate (<id>-<frame>.jpg); `face` is `largest` (default), `left`, `right`, `upper`, or an explicit [x, y, w, h] box in frame pixels. Reviewed 2026-09-15 against the episode thumbnails: in the FORM studio episodes (S2E2, S2E3, S2E5) the guest sits on the right and the beige-jacketed host on the left; S2E8's five frames all show the guest alone but the detector once read his hands as a face; S1E19 samples a group photograph and a parade in the b-roll; S2E4's frame 4 is the guest alone where frame 3 is a two-shot. Reviewed 2026-10-15 on Ney's word: S1E7 (Sajan Kumar) had a false face on his shirt win as largest; S1E10 (Raju Vishwas) had picked the host Sunny, and S1E9 (Krishna Kamthorn) the host Uncle Chan, Sunny's father. Boxes are from the detector on the pinned frames.
